model: Bank FCFE capitalisation at cost of equity (engine route; GAAP earnings after regulatory capital retention, preferred stock deducted in the equity bridge, net debt zero)

equity_bridge.item: Preferred stock (Series B, C, E; liquidation value)
equity_bridge.note: us-gaap:PreferredStockLiquidationPreferenceValue $1,400m at 30 Jun 2026 (Q2 2026 10-Q; carrying value $1,369m). Dividends ~$82m/yr (H1 2026 $41m). Deducted at liquidation value because the flows are total net income before preferred dividends.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 1.1% vs EPS 5yr 17.5%: book value is depressed by AOCI swings (-3.3bn at FY2022 from AFS marks) and ~$5bn of buybacks since 2018, while FY2020 EPS (1.03) is a COVID-provisioning trough that flatters the 5yr EPS CAGR. Neither is a forward growth rate; revenue CAGR is used.
historical_growth.notes: Revenue = NII + noninterest income from XBRL 10-K tags: FY2015 5,378; FY2020 6,287; FY2022 7,215; FY2025 7,526. FY2022-23 revenue was inflated by the rate cycle (FY2023 NII 5,320 peak) then fell back as deposit costs re-priced; the 3yr CAGR (1.4%) is measured from that elevated base. FCF CAGRs are null: operating cash flow is meaningless for a bank. Diluted shares fell 963m (FY2021) -> 857m (Q2 2026), so per-share growth runs ~2pp/yr ahead of aggregate growth.

scenario_narratives.base: Regions grows revenue ~4% for two years as its fixed-rate asset book and hedges reprice and the Southeast footprint keeps adding loans and low-cost deposits, then tapers to nominal-GDP-like 2.5%. Efficiency drifts from ~57% to ~56%, credit normalises to a ~45bp mid-cycle loss rate, and roughly 80% of earnings are distributed through the dividend and buybacks while CET1 is held near 10%. Valued as FCFE at a 10% cost of equity with preferred deducted.
scenario_narratives.bull: Southeast in-migration and share gains from smaller banks lift loan growth to ~5%, a steeper curve pushes NIM toward the high 3s, and fee lines (wealth, capital markets, treasury management) compound at ~7%. Positive operating leverage takes the efficiency ratio to ~54% with benign credit, so pre-tax margins exceed 40% and buybacks keep shrinking the share count.
scenario_narratives.bear: Fed cuts compress NIM on an asset-sensitive balance sheet while a CRE (office, multifamily) and consumer credit cycle in the Southeast takes provisions to ~11% of revenue in FY28. Revenue shrinks, regulators push for capital rebuild and AOCI recognition under the Basel III endgame re-proposal, and distributions are cut. Recovery leaves a slightly lower through-cycle margin and 2% terminal growth.

valuation_philosophy.summary: A bank is valued on what it can pay its shareholders: net income less the capital it must retain to keep growing at its regulatory ratio, capitalised at the cost of equity. Deposits and wholesale funding are the raw material of the business, not debt to be subtracted. Regions earns a mid-to-high-teens return on tangible common equity on a granular Southeast deposit franchise; at ~2x tangible book the market already prices most of that.
key_risks_to_valuation: Credit cycle: Southeast CRE and consumer losses could take provisions to 2-3x mid-cycle (FY2020 provision was 21% of revenue).
Rate path: Fed cuts compress NIM on an asset-sensitive balance sheet; deposit betas on the way down may lag.
Basel III endgame / AOCI: recognising the ~$1.9bn after-tax AOCI loss in CET1 would cut excess capital and buybacks.
Deposit flight: 2023 regional-bank stress showed uninsured-deposit runs can force balance-sheet repositioning losses.
Share count and preferred figures at the valuation date are partly estimated (Q3 buybacks) and should be refreshed from the Q3 2026 10-Q.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 22.70-32.47
data_sources.financials: SEC XBRL companyfacts (CIK 0001281761): 10-K FY2015-FY2025 and 10-Q Q1/Q2 2026 tags InterestIncomeExpenseNet, NoninterestIncome, NoninterestExpense, ProvisionForLoanLeaseAndOtherLosses, IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit, NetIncomeLoss, PreferredStockLiquidationPreferenceValue, Goodwill, AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense, PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock; dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding (5 Aug 2026). RF_Metrics.csv for EPS, equity and share-count history.
data_sources.qualitative: RF_Analysis.json (2026-10-02): FY2026 guidance, CET1, NIM, branch programme, risks.

inputs.base_revenue_definition: FY2026E total revenue = net interest income + noninterest income (GAAP, not FTE). FY2026 ends 31 Dec 2026 and is unreported, so FY0 = H1 2026 actual 3,780 (NII 2,525 + noninterest income 1,255; Q2 2026 10-Q, us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNet / NoninterestIncome) + H2 2026 at ~1,935/quarter (Q2 2026 run-rate 1,907 = NII 1,277 + fees 630, with modest NIM expansion from fixed-rate asset repricing). FY2025 actual 7,526 (NII 4,991 + fees 2,535), so FY0 is +1.6%. Using FY2026E as FY0 puts year 1 = FY2027, one year from the valuation date. The CSV `Revenue` column (FY2016-FY2021 ~58-104, blank thereafter) is an ASC-606 fee subset tag and is NOT bank revenue; every revenue figure here comes from the NII + noninterest income XBRL tags.
inputs.share_count_basis: 851.9m common shares outstanding at 5 Aug 2026 (Q2 2026 10-Q cover, dei:EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding 851,929,506) PLUS ~5m dilutive restricted/performance awards (Q2 2026 diluted weighted average 857m vs ~852-853m basic) LESS an ESTIMATED ~3m shares repurchased Aug-Sep 2026 (buybacks slowed to $59m in Q2 2026 after $401m in Q1) = ~854m fully diluted at the valuation date. Held FLAT thereafter: share-based compensation (~$70m/yr) is expensed in the flows, so charging dilution as well would double-count; buybacks are a distribution of the FCFE capitalised, not a separate driver. REFRESH from the Q3 2026 10-Q cover (due early Nov 2026).
inputs.funding_note: Net debt is held at ZERO by construction. Regions is a Fed-regulated bank holding company: long-term debt $4,628m and short-term borrowings $3,000m at 30 Jun 2026 and deposits $130,710m are operating funding whose cost is already inside net interest income; cash and due from banks $3,177m plus interest-bearing deposits in banks $6,749m are liquidity held against that funding, not surplus. The flow capitalised is free cash flow to equity (net income less capital retained to hold CET1 at target as risk-weighted assets grow) at the cost of equity, so no debt is deducted and no cash is added. total_debt and cash are recorded for audit only. Preferred stock ($1,400m liquidation value, $1,369m carrying; ~$82m/yr dividends) is senior to common and deducted in equity_bridge; the flows are therefore total net income BEFORE preferred dividends, so the preferred cost is charged exactly once.
inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2026E FCFE = GAAP net income ~2,235 (H1 2026 actual 1,129; H2 at ~553/quarter = (1,935 revenue - ~1,115 noninterest expense - ~120 provision) x (1 - 21.2%)) LESS capital retained ~510 (~4% RWA growth x ~$12.7bn of CET1 required at a ~10% target; loans grew 95.6bn -> 99.2bn gross in H1 2026). Cross-check on distributions: FY2026 common dividends ~$905m ($1.06 annualised x ~855m) + buybacks ~$600-700m (H1 $460m) = ~$1.55bn, i.e. ~70% of GAAP NI, with CET1 held near 10.5-11%. reported_fcf = FCFE + SBC so that last_fcf = reported_fcf - sbc_incl_equity_taxes - interest_income holds.
inputs.reported_fcf_note: Statutory operating cash flow (FY2025 2,181; FY2024 1,598; Q2 2026 369) is loan/deposit/trading movement and is meaningless as free cash flow for a bank; the CSV FreeCashFlow column is NOT used. reported_fcf here is the FCFE proxy before the SBC charge.
inputs.sbc_source: us-gaap:AllocatedShareBasedCompensationExpense FY2025 $69m (10-K equity-award note; ShareBasedCompensation cash-flow tag not used by Regions); FY2024 $73m and FY2023 $61m (CSV StockBasedComp). Taxes withheld on net-share settlement (PaymentsRelatedToTaxWithholdingForShareBasedCompensation) FY2025 $23m, H1 2026 $25m are inside the expense already recognised and are not added again. ~0.9% of revenue, so house and street bases are close.
inputs.interest_income_note: Not stripped: interest income IS the banking business, and no cash is added to equity value (matching-asset rule satisfied in the other direction).
inputs.buyback_note: PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock $460m in H1 2026 ($401m Q1, $59m Q2); FY2025 $1,067m, FY2024 $348m, FY2023 $252m. Diluted share count fell from 938m (FY2023) to 857m (Q2 2026), -8.6%. Buybacks are a use of the FCFE capitalised, not an extra source of value.
inputs.book_value_anchors: 30 Jun 2026: total equity 18,840 - preferred 1,369 - goodwill 5,733 - other intangibles 126 = tangible common equity 11,612 -> TBVPS ~$13.63 on 852m shares; price is ~1.98x TBV. AOCI -1,922 is inside TCE (ex-AOCI TBVPS ~$15.89, 1.70x). FY2025 ROTCE ~17.5% reported basis (NI to common 2,061 / average TCE ~11.8bn), ~15% ex-AOCI.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Single cost of equity 10.0% across scenarios (risk is charged in the scenario cash flows, not twice through the rate): US 10-year ~4.3% + beta ~1.15 x 5.0% ERP = ~10.0%. USD flows, USD rate. Regional banks carry a premium to money-centre peers for deposit-run and CRE concentration risk (2023 precedent); that premium is in the beta. House precedent: HBAN 10.5% (merger-integration premium), NAB.AX 9.7%.
inputs.lease_treatment: Bank: operating-lease expense sits inside noninterest expense, which is inside the margin; no separate lease line.
inputs.notes: MODEL: Bank FCFE capitalisation at cost of equity through the component engine route, per the dcf-methods routing row for banks and the house precedent for US/AU banks (HBAN, NTRS, NAB.AX, GL): an owner-FCF/WACC DCF is meaningless for a deposit-funded bank. Engine mapping: revenue = NII + noninterest income; 'ebitda_margin' = pre-tax income + SBC as % of revenue (i.e. 100 - efficiency ratio - provision ratio + SBC%); D&A = 0 (inside noninterest expense); 'capex' = capital retained to hold CET1 at target as RWA grow (~1.66 x revenue growth, from ~$12.7bn required CET1 / ~$7.65bn revenue); cash tax = GAAP effective rate. Preferred deducted in equity_bridge; net debt zero. First valuation of RF; no MEMORY entry existed. Excess CET1 above target (RF ran ~10.7% at Q2 2026 vs a ~9.25-9.75% operating range) is NOT added as surplus capital - treated as a buffer against Basel III endgame AOCI recognition, which would cost Category IV banks like RF roughly the unrealised AFS loss in CET1 if phased in. RF_Analysis.json cross-checked: FY2026 guidance NII growth 2.5-4% (FY0 implies ~+2.5%, NII 2,525 H1 + ~2,590 H2 vs 4,991 FY2025 - low end, conservative), Q2 2026 NIM 3.66%, CET1 ~10.7% at Q2 2026, 2026 Frazer Lanier municipal-finance acquisition (immaterial to scale), 130-150 branch openings over 3-5 years offset by equal closures (inside the efficiency path).

bear.growth_rationale: Rate cuts compress NIM (asset-sensitive deposit base reprices slower than floating loans) and a Southeast CRE/consumer credit cycle shrinks loan demand in FY27-28; recovery to 2-3% thereafter.
bear.margin_rationale: FY28 credit trough: provision ~11% of revenue (~90bp NCO plus reserve build, cf. FY2020 provision 1,330 = 21% of revenue in a severe case) on efficiency ~60% as revenue falls; mature 36.5 = efficiency 57.5 - provision 6.9 (higher through-cycle losses) + 0.9.
bear.capex_rationale: Retention above 1.66 x g in FY27-28 despite flat RWA: CET1 buffer rebuild through the credit cycle and Basel III endgame AOCI phase-in; then 1.66 x g.

base.growth_rationale: Total revenue. FY27 4.0%: average loans +3-4% (H1 2026 gross loans +3.7% annualised, Southeast footprint population growth), NII +3-4% as fixed-rate loans/securities and the hedging book reprice above roll-off yields, fees +5% (wealth, capital markets, treasury management). Tapers to 2.5% terminal (nominal GDP less deposit-beta creep). Brackets the 3.4-3.7% 5yr/10yr revenue CAGR.
base.margin_rationale: Pre-tax income + SBC on revenue = 100 - GAAP efficiency ratio - provision/revenue + SBC 0.9. FY27 38.1 = 100 - 57.0 efficiency - 5.8 provision + 0.9. FY2025 actual: efficiency 57.3% (4,313/7,526), provision 6.2% (470), pre-tax 36.4%. H1 2026: efficiency 57.9%, provision 4.2% (reserve release; NCOs 232 = 6.1% of revenue), pre-tax 37.9%. Mature 38.9 = efficiency 56.0 (modest positive operating leverage, technology spend absorbed) - mid-cycle provision 6.0 (~45bp NCO on ~$100bn loans) + 0.9.
base.capex_rationale: Capital retained to hold CET1 at ~10% as RWA grow with revenue = growth x required CET1 (~$12.7bn) / revenue (~$7.65bn) = ~1.66 x g. FY27-28 at 4% growth: 6.6% of revenue (~$525m, ~22% of NPAT retained -> ~78% distributed, consistent with the ~$905m dividend + ~$0.9bn buybacks pattern of FY2025). Steps down with growth to 4.2% at the 2.5% terminal rate (~15% retained).
base.tax_rationale: GAAP effective rate: FY2025 21.4% (587/2,743), H1 2026 21.2% (303/1,432); 21% federal + state less tax-exempt income and LIHTC credits. Cash taxes paid ran lower (FY2024 64, FY2025 178) on tax-credit investments; not capitalised in perpetuity.

bull.growth_rationale: Southeast deposit/loan share gains plus a steeper curve lifting NIM toward ~3.7%; fees +7% on wealth and capital-markets build-out.
bull.margin_rationale: Efficiency ratio improves to ~54% (positive operating leverage of 2-3pp/yr as revenue outruns ~3% expense growth); provision holds ~5.5% (benign credit, ~40bp NCO); + SBC 0.9.
bull.capex_rationale: Retention = 1.66 x revenue growth, as base; faster growth consumes more capital.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 14x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Symmetric 25/50/25 rather than the 15/50/35 house default, matching the bank precedents (NTRS, HBAN): regional banks carry fat-tailed credit and deposit-flight risk (2023), RF's earnings are rate-sensitive in both directions, and the Basel III endgame AOCI treatment is unresolved. No solvency risk is in view (CET1 ~10.5-11%, $130bn deposits largely retail/core), so bear is not overweighted.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
sanity_check.fy_end_month_source: December (fallback: no fiscal_year_end and no annual filing)
